statement: Google Cloud A5X (Vera Rubin) delivers 10x lower inference cost per token versus the prior generation and one-tenth the cost per million tokens versus GB200 NVL72.
why: Sharply lower cost per token expands inference demand via price elasticity.

impact.mechanism: Falling token cost lowers the price of inference and stimulates volume demand.

evidence.excerpt: 10x lower inference cost per token and 10x higher token throughput per megawatt

confidence.basis: Primary vendor source with named customer benchmark.
